description: Admin UI to revoke or extend existing attestations. Must: (1) list attestations with server name, verdict, valid_until, (2) allow extend (new valid_until date) or revoke action, (3) write audit_log entry for every action, (4) revoke triggers attestation_engine revocation flow via :8780. Target port 8790. X-API-Key auth. Table columns: attestation_id, server_id, verdict, valid_until, status.
